requirements.title: Build Telemetry Packet From Inputs
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall build a telemetry packet from caller-provided input fields on each call.
requirements.rationale: telem_lib is the packet builder consumed by the telemetry app at the SYS-019 2 Hz cadence.

requirements.title: Serialize Packet Into Caller Buffer
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall serialize each packet into a caller-provided byte buffer.
requirements.rationale: Caller-owned memory pattern; telem_lib performs no allocation and writes only to injected storage.

requirements.title: Packet Content Coverage
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall include timestamp, phase, GPS fix, baro altitude, nav state, voltage, validity, and health.
requirements.rationale: Mirrors SYS-020 packet content so ground monitoring sees full mission state.

requirements.title: Bounded Packet Size
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall produce packets whose serialized size does not exceed the configured maximum.
requirements.rationale: RYLR896 LoRa MTU bounds payload size; lora_lib must accept what telem_lib produces.

requirements.title: Integrity Field In Packet
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall append an integrity check field covering the packet contents.
requirements.rationale: Ground station decoder must validate packets against corruption over the LoRa link.

requirements.title: Phase-Independent Packet Production
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall produce a packet on every call regardless of flight phase.
requirements.rationale: SYS-021 mandates continuous coverage; telem_lib must not gate output on phase state.

requirements.title: Embed Sensor Health Bitmap
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall embed the caller-provided sensor health bitmap in each packet.
requirements.rationale: SYS-031 requires continuous health observability via every telemetry packet.

requirements.title: Embed Monotonic Microsecond Timestamp
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall embed the caller-provided monotonic microsecond timestamp in each packet.
requirements.rationale: SYS-026 mandates the monotonic time base on every record, including downlinked packets.

requirements.title: Deterministic Serialization
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall produce identical byte output for identical input fields.
requirements.rationale: SYS-044 determinism enables Trick regression and ground decoder consistency.

requirements.title: POSIX And Pico2 Equivalent Output
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall produce identical serialized bytes on POSIX and Pico2 builds for identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: SYS-043 functional equivalence so Trick simulation exercises the flight-side wire format.

requirements.title: No Radio Or UART I/O
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall not perform any UART or radio input or output operations.
requirements.rationale: Pure encoder scope; transmission belongs to lora_lib, preserving separation of concerns.

requirements.title: Embed Navigation Validity Flag
requirements.description: The telemetry library shall embed the caller-provided navigation validity flag in each packet.
requirements.rationale: SYS-020 packet content includes validity so ground consumers can gate use of nav fields.
